boneName.description: Base bone name as three.js sees it: spaces → _, dots and colons removed, a trailing _<number> export index dropped ("hand.L" → "handL", "mixamorig:Hips" → "mixamorigHips", "Left arm_20" → "Left_arm").

regex.description: JavaScript RegExp source tested against base bone names.

id.description: Stable id saved as the player's choice. Must be unique.

name.description: Name shown in the character picker.

order.description: Sort order (lower first). The lowest built-in pack is the default host.

model.description: Character GLB (compressed: meshopt + webp textures recommended).

animations.description: Optional GLB holding extra clips (Idle, Walk/Walking) for the same skeleton.

voiceStart.description: Played when the host greets the audience.

voiceCongrats.description: Played when the winning ticket is shown.

height.description: Standing height on stage in metres (the cage is ~1.45 m tall).

materials.description: toon: unlit anime export converted to toon shading. lit: keep the GLB's PBR materials.

centreOn.description: hips: for big tails/capes that would shift the bounding-box centre.

useClips.description: Play the GLB's own Idle / Walk clips for body and legs; arms, gaze and lean stay procedural on top.

bones.description: Logical bone → base bone name. lMid/rMid = palm attach point (middle finger base, or the hand bone for mittens). lToe/rToe can repeat the ankle bone if there are no toes.

palmBones.description: Index and pinky knuckle bones per hand. With them the palm direction is measured each frame (palm-up holding, palms facing to clap). null for mitten hands.

springs.description: Secondary-motion bones (hair, ears, ribbons, hood…). First matching rule wins; gain 0..1.

skirtRoots.description: Root bones of skirt/coat strands, pushed by the thighs so legs never cut through.

hands.description: Which bones form the visible hand (wrist + fingers): 'match' selects them, 'left'/'right' decide the side.

motion.description: Fine-tuning of the shared animation. Every field is optional.

armRest.description: { out, hang, forward }: relaxed hands offset sideways (m), hang as a fraction of arm reach (1 = straight down), forward (m).

handReach.description: Grip point as a fraction of the mesh past the wrist: 1 for mittens, ~0.5 for real hands.

hold.description: { ballScale, lift }: ball display scale in the hand, lift above the palm (m).

clapHalfGap.description: Half the gap between the grip points when the palms meet (m).

pickup.description: { lean, crouch }: forward lean (rad) and knee crouch (m) when picking the ball off the tray.

carryHalfWidth.description: Hands' distance from the centre line carrying the ballot box (m).

carryForward.description: How far in front of the body the box is carried (m).

crankHop.description: Short characters jump this high while cranking (m).

reachStep.description: Short arms step this much closer to the crank knob (m).

trayStandoff.description: Stand further right of the tray mark (big heads) (m).

headClear.description: Big heads: hold presented things lower and wider (m).

ticketShot.description: { x, y }: slide the ticket close-up so the head stays out of frame (m).
